products.name: Defense and Aerospace Simulation, Geospatial, and AI Software Solutions
products.description: Development and delivery of simulation, geospatial, and operational software platforms for defense and homeland security, including 3D mapping, synthetic environments, GPS-denied navigation, AI training data generation, and geospatial intelligence. Delivered as software products and platforms to defense contractors and agencies.

products.name: Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAVs) and Drone Services
products.description: Provision of unmanned aerial vehicles (drones) and related services, including hardware sales, maintenance, aerial photography, mapping, imaging, and professional UAV pilot training for defense, homeland security, and civilian sectors. Delivered as end-to-end UAV solutions and services.

products.name: Precision Motion Control Systems for Defense Platforms
products.description: Design, engineering, and manufacturing of high-performance, gearless servo motion control systems for military and civilian use, enabling precise stabilization, tracking, and pointing for sensors, radar, communications, and weapon stations. Delivered as custom hardware systems for integration into defense platforms.

products.name: Integrated Electro-Mechanical Machines and Assembly Lines
products.description: Design, development, and serial manufacturing of fully integrated electro-mechanical machines, assembly lines, and custom OEM systems for defense, industrial, and commercial applications. Delivered as build-to-spec and build-to-print engineering and manufacturing solutions.

products.name: AI-Based Perimeter Security and Command & Control Software
products.description: Development and deployment of artificial intelligence software platforms for real-time perimeter security, monitoring, and command and control, integrating with cameras, sensors, and robotic assets for autonomous detection, analysis, and response. Delivered as middleware and SaaS solutions to defense, government, and commercial clients.

products.name: Distribution of Advanced Drone Payloads for Defense and Homeland Security
products.description: Exclusive U.S. distribution of advanced drone payload systems developed by third parties (e.g., Blade Ranger Ltd.) for military and homeland security applications. Delivered as hardware products to defense and security organizations under distribution agreements.

products.name: Aviation and Defense Infrastructure Services (Joint Venture)
products.description: Development and operation of aviation and defense infrastructure, including NATO-compliant logistics hubs, maintenance, repair and operations (MRO) facilities, and aircraft modernization services, through a joint venture. Delivered as infrastructure and service solutions to civil and defense aviation clients.

products.name: LNG and Natural Gas Supply
products.description: Production, procurement, and supply of liquefied natural gas (LNG) and natural gas to external customers, including regasified LNG from owned floating liquefaction units and third-party sources, delivered under long-term and spot contracts. This involves physical production, shipping, and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: LNG Terminal and Regasification Services
products.description: Operation and leasing of LNG import, storage, and regasification terminals, including floating storage and regasification units (FSRUs) and onshore/offshore facilities, enabling customers to receive, store, and regasify LNG for local distribution or industrial use. Requires regulated infrastructure and physical assets.

products.name: Natural Gas-Fired Power Generation and Sales
products.description: Development, ownership, and operation of natural gas-fired power plants, selling electricity under long-term power purchase agreements to utilities and industrial customers. Involves physical plant construction, regulated infrastructure, and in-person operations.

products.name: LNG Shipping and Vessel Chartering
products.description: Leasing, ownership, and operation of LNG carriers, floating storage units, and FSRUs, providing marine transportation and storage services for LNG to third-party customers under long-term or spot arrangements. Requires regulated maritime assets and logistics management.

products.name: Operation and Maintenance Services for Power Generation Assets
products.description: Provision of operation and maintenance (O&M) services for third-party thermal power generation assets, including management and technical support, under long-term contracts. Delivered via in-person human labor and technical expertise.

products.name: Commercial Lending
products.description: Provides commercial loans, including commercial real estate loans, equipment leasing, and lines of credit to businesses. These are originated and serviced through in-person banking relationships and require significant financial capital and risk management.

products.name: Consumer and Residential Lending
products.description: Offers consumer loans such as residential mortgages, home equity loans and lines of credit, and other personal loans to individuals. These are delivered through branch networks and digital channels, requiring underwriting and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Deposit Services
products.description: Provides a range of deposit products including demand checking, NOW, money market, and savings accounts to retail and business customers. Delivered through physical branches, ATMs, and digital banking platforms, requiring regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Cash Management and Payment Processing Services
products.description: Offers cash management solutions and commercial payment processing, including payroll deposit services for business clients. These services are delivered via digital platforms and require regulated financial infrastructure.

products.name: Wealth Management and Investment Advisory Services
products.description: Provides wealth management, investment advisory, and trust services to individuals, families, endowments, and foundations through Clarendon Private and the Bank's Trust and Investments Division. Delivered via in-person advisors and digital tools, requiring regulatory registration and fiduciary oversight.

products.name: Small Business Administration (SBA) Lending
products.description: Originates SBA 7A loans for small businesses, some of which are sold to investors. Requires specialized underwriting and compliance with government lending programs.

products.name: Foreign Exchange Services
products.description: Provides foreign exchange services to business and retail customers, facilitating international transactions. Delivered through digital and in-person channels, requiring specialized financial infrastructure.

products.name: Women's Contemporary Apparel
products.description: A portfolio of women's contemporary apparel including dresses, tops, sweaters, bottoms, jumpsuits, rompers, jackets, and sets, designed and produced primarily in Los Angeles using luxe fabrics and on-trend designs. Products are sold through direct-to-consumer digital channels and wholesale distribution to specialty boutiques and department stores.

products.name: Denim and Essential Wardrobe Apparel
products.description: Minimalist, high-quality denim and essential wardrobe pieces such as jeans, t-shirts, tops, and casual pants, produced with attention to detail from premium materials. Sold primarily direct-to-consumer via digital channels, eliminating wholesale mark-up for sharper pricing.

products.name: Collegiate Licensed Loungewear
products.description: Collegiate-branded loungewear including t-shirts, tanks, fleece sweats, shorts, and other products, designed in collaboration with universities and featuring student-athletes and Greek life. Manufactured using shared supply chain infrastructure and sold direct-to-consumer and through university bookstores.

products.name: ALXN1840 for Wilson Disease
products.description: An investigational, orally-administered small molecule drug designed to selectively bind and remove copper from the body for the treatment of Wilson disease. Manufactured via third-party contract manufacturing and delivered as an oral medication, pending regulatory approval.

products.name: MNPR-101 Radiopharmaceuticals for Oncology
products.description: A suite of proprietary radiopharmaceuticals based on the MNPR-101 humanized monoclonal antibody, targeting uPAR-expressing advanced solid tumors for both imaging (diagnostic) and therapy. Includes MNPR-101-Zr (zirconium-89 conjugate) for PET imaging, MNPR-101-Lu (lutetium-177 conjugate) and MNPR-101-Ac (actinium-225 conjugate) for therapeutic use. These are biologic drugs manufactured by third-party vendors and delivered via injection, pending regulatory approval.

products.name: Threaded Fasteners and Related Hardware
products.description: A broad line of threaded fasteners (bolts, nuts, screws, studs, washers) and related hardware (pins, keys, anchors, metal framing, wire rope, strut, rivets) distributed primarily under the Fastenal brand, sourced globally and delivered through a physical and digital network.

products.name: Safety Supplies
products.description: A comprehensive line of safety products including personal protective equipment and related items, distributed under the Body Guard brand and others, delivered via branches, onsite inventory, and industrial vending.

products.name: General Industrial and Construction Supplies
products.description: A wide range of non-fastener industrial and construction supplies (tools, maintenance, repair, and operations products) distributed through the same channels as fasteners, including branches, onsite, and vending.

products.name: Private Label Industrial Products
products.description: Industrial and construction supplies sold under exclusive Fastenal brands (ORMADUS for global, Body Guard for safety), covering a range of categories and distributed through all channels.

products.name: Industrial Vending and Managed Inventory Services (FMI)
products.description: Provision, installation, and management of industrial vending machines (FASTVend), bin stock systems (FASTStock, FASTBin), and related inventory management services at customer sites, including digital monitoring and automated replenishment.

products.name: Digital Supply Chain Solutions and Analytics
products.description: Digital platforms and software (eBusiness, eProcurement, FAST360°, FASTCrib, analytics, mobile apps) that provide customers with procurement, inventory visibility, spend analytics, and supply chain management tools, delivered as cloud-based or integrated digital services.

products.name: Manufactured and Custom Fastener Products
products.description: Custom and non-standard fasteners and hardware manufactured to customer specifications at Fastenal's own facilities, including proprietary brands (Holo-Krome, Cardinal Fasteners, Spensall), delivered directly to customers.

products.name: Industrial Services (Tool and Equipment Repair, Fabrication)
products.description: A suite of industrial services including tool and hoist repair, chain sling and hose fabrication, band saw blade welding, packaging, and other light manufacturing and fabrication, performed at Fastenal facilities or customer sites.

products.name: Zola Coconut Water
products.description: A line of coconut water beverages sourced, processed, and packaged in Thailand, sold in various flavors through grocery retailers and foodservice distributors across the U.S. Production involves agricultural sourcing, overseas processing, and distribution via retail and foodservice channels.

products.name: Integrated Power Control Room Substations (PCRs)
products.description: Custom-engineered, prefabricated electrical substations that integrate power distribution, control, and monitoring systems, manufactured in dedicated facilities and delivered as turnkey solutions for large-scale projects.

products.name: Electrical Houses (E-Houses) and Custom-Engineered Modules
products.description: Prefabricated, modular enclosures housing electrical and control equipment, engineered and manufactured to customer specifications for rapid deployment and installation at industrial sites.

products.name: Distribution Switchgear and Control Gear
products.description: Manufactured medium- and low-voltage switchgear and control gear, including arc-resistant designs, for safe and reliable distribution and control of electrical power in industrial and utility applications.

products.name: Medium-Voltage Circuit Breakers
products.description: Engineered and manufactured medium-voltage circuit breakers, including vacuum circuit breakers, for protection and control of electrical systems in industrial and utility settings.

products.name: Monitoring and Control Communications Systems (including SCADA RTUs)
products.description: Design and manufacture of monitoring and control systems, including Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Remote Terminal Units (RTUs), for automation and remote management of electrical substations and distribution networks.

products.name: Motor Control Centers, Switches, and Bus Duct Systems
products.description: Manufacture and integration of motor control centers, electrical switches, and bus duct systems for industrial power distribution and motor management applications.

products.name: Spare Parts, Retrofit and Retrofill Components, and Replacement Circuit Breakers
products.description: Supply of spare parts, retrofit and retrofill components, and replacement circuit breakers for existing and obsolete electrical systems, supporting ongoing maintenance and system upgrades.

products.name: Field Services (Inspection, Installation, Commissioning, Modification, and Repair)
products.description: Provision of field services including inspection, installation, commissioning, modification, and repair of electrical equipment and systems, delivered by skilled technicians at customer sites.

products.name: Digital Healthcare Marketing Solutions
products.description: Tech-enabled marketing solutions for life sciences brands, leveraging proprietary AI-driven platforms to deliver targeted messaging to healthcare providers and patients via digital channels. Delivered through a cloud-based, omnichannel network integrated with EHR systems, eRx platforms, and programmatic media.

products.name: Dynamic Audience Activation Platform (DAAP)
products.description: AI-enabled platform that identifies and activates precise healthcare provider and patient audiences for targeted marketing campaigns, using predictive analytics and machine learning. Delivered as a SaaS solution with potential for subscription-based revenue.

products.name: Micro-Neighborhood Targeting (MNT)
products.description: Patent-protected, privacy-centric audience targeting solution that uses de-identified claims data to identify and prioritize geographic areas with eligible patients for direct-to-consumer marketing. Delivered via integration with various digital media channels.

products.name: Audience Profiling (Profiler)
products.description: Audience profiling service that provides insights into target consumers, identifying optimal channels, partners, and strategies for marketing campaigns. Delivered as a data-driven analytics solution to maximize marketing efficiency.

products.name: Media Execution and Omnichannel Campaign Delivery
products.description: Execution of digital media campaigns for healthcare providers and consumer audiences, including banner messaging, programmatic display, CTV/OTT, social media, addressable TV, digital out-of-home, audio, and email/direct mail. Delivered via proprietary and partner networks.

products.name: Pharmacy Alerts
products.description: Real-time alert service for prescribers, indicating which pharmacies can dispense a patient’s prescription, integrated within EHR and eRx workflows. Delivered digitally to improve prescription fulfillment efficiency.

products.name: Financial Messaging (Copay Offers)
products.description: Digital delivery of branded copay offers and affordability messaging to prescribers within EHR and eRx platforms, enabling prescribers to provide patients with cost-saving information at the point of care. Delivered via proprietary integrations with healthcare IT systems.

products.name: Embedded FPGA (eFPGA) Intellectual Property Licensing
products.description: Licensing of embedded FPGA (eFPGA) IP cores that enable semiconductor companies to integrate programmable logic blocks into their ASICs and SoC devices. Delivered as licensable IP, often customized using the Australis automated IP generator, and supported by professional engineering services for integration.

products.name: Discrete FPGA Devices
products.description: Manufacture and sale of standalone FPGA semiconductor devices, including both reprogrammable (SRAM-based) and one-time programmable (ViaLink antifuse-based) architectures. Devices are fabricated by third-party foundries and delivered as physical silicon chips for use in customer hardware systems.

products.name: Programmable Silicon Platforms (SoC Devices with Integrated Programmable Logic)
products.description: Development and sale of silicon platforms that combine programmable logic with fixed-function hardware blocks and mixed-signal capabilities, such as the EOS S3 and ArcticLink product families. Delivered as physical semiconductor devices for system-level integration.

products.name: FPGA User Tools and Development Software
products.description: Provision of proprietary and open-source software tools that enable customers to design, configure, and deploy programmable logic functionality in QuickLogic's FPGA devices and eFPGA IP. Delivered as downloadable or licensed software supporting both proprietary and open-source workflows.

products.name: Professional Engineering Services for eFPGA Integration
products.description: Professional services supporting the development and integration of eFPGA technology into customer semiconductor devices, including design, customization, and support during the integration process. Delivered as engineering consulting and support contracts.

products.name: ExPERT Electroporation Instruments
products.description: A family of benchtop electroporation instruments (DTx, ATx, STx, GTx, VLx) designed and manufactured in-house, enabling scalable, high-efficiency transfection of cells for research, drug discovery, clinical development, and cGMP manufacturing of cell therapies and biologics. Instruments are sold or licensed for research, clinical, and commercial use.

products.name: Processing Assemblies (PAs) and Consumables
products.description: Proprietary single-use processing assemblies (PAs) and related consumables, including electroporation buffer solutions and accessories, designed for use with ExPERT instruments to enable scalable, sterile, and efficient cell transfection from small to very large volumes. Manufactured in-house and through third parties, these are sold for both research and clinical applications.

products.name: Electroporation Buffer
products.description: A proprietary, GMP-grade, chemically defined electroporation buffer formulated for use with all ExPERT instruments and PAs, supporting high cell viability and efficiency across cell types and scales. Produced by third parties and sold as a consumable for research and clinical manufacturing.

products.name: Gene Editing Risk Assessment Assays and Services (SeQure Dx)
products.description: A suite of proprietary and licensed assays and associated services (e.g., GUIDE-seq, ONE-seq, Guide Profiler, SAFER Detection) for on-target and off-target gene editing assessment, offered to cell and gene therapy developers to support R&D, regulatory filings, and clinical development. Delivered as laboratory services and analytical tools.

products.name: Strategic Platform Licenses (SPLs) and Instrument Licensing
products.description: Non-exclusive licensing agreements granting customers access to ExPERT instruments, intellectual property, regulatory support (FDA Master File), and technical expertise for research, clinical, and commercial use. Includes recurring annual license fees, milestone payments, and sales-based payments tied to customer therapeutic development and commercialization.

products.name: Gene and Cell Therapy Manufacturing Enablement
products.description: Provision of enabling platform technologies, including instruments, disposables, and protocols, to biopharmaceutical and cell therapy companies for the discovery, development, and manufacturing of next-generation cell and gene therapies, including ex vivo engineered cell therapies. Delivered through product sales, licensing, and technical support.
